description: Twenty-four source-linked candidate research cases for expert review and annotation. This is a curation seed pack, not a scored or adjudicated benchmark.

provenance.collection_method: Questions and candidate propositions were authored from official framework documentation, standards, protocol specifications, and project documentation. Source URL metadata was checked on 2026-11-28; source text has not been captured or frozen.
provenance.corpus_description: Twenty-four draft cases spanning agent orchestration, Python concurrency, SQLite, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, HTTP caching, OAuth PKCE, W3C provenance, NIST AI risk management, and OWASP prompt-injection concepts. Candidate propositions require expert review and independent annotation.
provenance.dataset_license: Original questions and candidate propositions: release license not yet selected. Linked source documents are not copied into this dataset and remain subject to their respective terms and licenses.
provenance.curation_notes: All cases are deliberately draft. Each snapshot is unfrozen; source licenses and redistribution permissions are unverified; no annotator labels, evidence spans, or adjudications are included. Do not use this file for model-quality claims, regression thresholds, or benchmark leaderboard results.
